Inputs.Name: user
Inputs.Label: The account the keys sign in as

Inputs.Name: key
Inputs.Label: The public keys, one per line: type base64 [comment]

Writes.Note: the block station:authorized-key, between its two marker lines (`/root/.ssh` for root); the folder and the file losing the write of group and others when they have it and the user owns them, each made 0700 and 0600 and the user's when station makes it, one already there the user's or refused, as is a file with another name; off takes the file and the folder away once empty when station made them
root's, 0600: every file station wrote the block in, the block's text and whether station made the file and its folder, which drift and off read, whoever runs station
empty: the lock apply and off hold around the record; inside it each ~/.ssh they write in is held, the folder itself, the lock the VM's guest takes too

name: base-debian

    kind: workspace

vm:
    lifetime: ephemeral
    resources: { cpus: 4, memory: 8G, disk: 20G }
    network: nat

        from: 'ghcr.io/cirruslabs/debian@sha256:74f0de37c757af07910e18fec88c80bcf828259ff01a0b0e1daa596b3281c7cb'
